links.outcome: Image-interpretation accuracy of structured versus zero-shot prompt architectures
links.effect: Mean Total Score rose from 3.47 ± 1.33 (zero-shot P1) to 4.77 ± 0.68 (HRG P3); Full Accuracy rose from 23.3% to 86.7%; failures on 3 or more variables fell from 20.0% to 3.3%.
links.quote: Mean Total Score increased from 3.47 ± 1.33 for P1 to 4.77 ± 0.68 for P3, while Full Accuracy increased from 23.3% to 86.7%.

unlisted_practices: Hierarchical Reasoning Gates: staged prompt protocol with validation checks before the model may progress, for multimodal dental image interpretation

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the effect of a prompt-level safeguarding/structuring protocol (Hierarchical Reasoning Gates vs standard prompts) on the diagnostic accuracy and error patterns of an MLLM interpreting dental images.
